ERR_DISPLAY_BAD_WINDOW.message: Window ({x1}, {y1}) to ({x2}, {y2}) does not fit {id} or the pixels sent
ERR_DISPLAY_BAD_WINDOW.hint: Draw inside the panel's size (its geometry).

ERR_DISPLAY_FLUSH_BUSY.message: {id} is still drawing the previous window

ERR_DISPLAY_TRANSFER.hint: Check the display's wiring and its SPI clock.

ERR_DISPLAY_FLUSH_TIMEOUT.message: {id} did not finish drawing within {ms} ms
ERR_DISPLAY_FLUSH_TIMEOUT.hint: The display was reset. Check its wiring, its SPI clock and the bus it shares.
